$note: All 69 states completed in both themes: 134 scored pairs and four explicitly unsupported attempts. All 67 scored states were visually reviewed on fresh-name, worst-first Electron/Rune sheets, including the worst 25 below. Both clients show the Browser rail and Updates card; the previous Chrome-host absence classifications are withdrawn. Electron's Updates card is NOT hidden in this development launch: it says Updates are available in installed builds, not development, and disables Check for updates. Rune's headless card instead reads Reading update status with Check enabled. This is an updater-state/headless limitation, not an extra card. The layout category includes substantial scroll/reflow mismatches in Side chat and middle history; it does not imply a small pixel error. Streaming and WKWebView canvas remain unscored. All 134 scored snapshot digests stayed unchanged. This is visual parity evidence, not interaction or atomic presentation sign-off; no fresh-fixture byte-repeatability claim is made for this Electron corpus.
